verdict.rationale: Substantive guidance text was extracted from several canada.ca CRA pages (business registration overview, e-services, EFILE, agency home), which indirectly indicates the public reading surface serves readable content. The llms.txt probe got a plain HTTP 302 with no challenge page, which shows the platform answers non-browser requests normally, though it says nothing directly about the guidance pages. No probe directly confirms keyless fetches of the guidance pages with an identified user agent. missing for 10: a direct probe of guidance pages with an identified agent user agent showing HTTP 200 and server-rendered HTML (no JS-only shell), explicit evidence of no CAPTCHA or bot-wall challenge, independent hands-on corroboration.
